newsitem.title: USA: Bomb explodes outside California courthouse.
newsitem.headline: Bomb explodes outside California courthouse.

text.p: A bomb exploded outside a county courthouse in California early on Thursday, blowing out windows but causing no injuries, police officials said.
The pre-dawn explosion in Vallejo, 35 miles (50 km) northeast of San Francisco, is the third bomb incident in the town in less than a week.

An explosion in Vallejo damaged a bank early on Sunday, hours after a bomb containing 30 sticks of dynamite was found and dismantled outside a public library there. Authorities believe all three incidents are related, but no arrests have been made and the bomber's motive is unknown.

In the latest blast, a bomb exploded just after 3:30 a.m. (1130 GMT) outside the Solano County courthouse in Vallejo, Dave Robinson, a spokesman for the Solano County Sheriff's Department, said. No one was injured, he said.
The blast blew a hole in the wall of the courthouse and shattered windows in the courthouse and in buildings across the street, witnesses at the scene said.

Authorities sealed off a two-square-block area of downtown Vallejo and searched for clues in the thick pre-dawn fog. Robinson said the Federal Bureau of Investigation was involved in the investigation.
Another sheriff's department spokesman said a nearby police department received an anonymous telephone call on Monday warning that a bomb would be placed at the Vallejo courthouse.
The building was evacuated and searched on Monday but no bomb was found, he said.
In the early hours of Sunday, a bomb exploded near a Wells Fargo Bank branch in Vallejo, damaging automated teller machines. No injuries were reported and no money was taken from the cash machines.

Hours earlier on Saturday afternoon, Vallejo police said a bomb that contained at least 30 sticks of dynamite was found by the wall of a downtown public library that houses a police evidence room in its basement. The area was evacuated as a bomb disposal team dismantled the device, police said.
